messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: You should not use lisinopril if you are allergic to it or to any other ACE (angiotensin converting enzyme) inhibitor such as captopril, fosinopril, enalapril, benazepril, moexipril, perindopril, quinapril, ramipril, or trandolapril.
Do not take lisinopril within 36 hours before or after taking medicine that contains sacubitril (such as Entresto).
If you have diabetes, do not take lisinopril with any medication that contains aliskiren (a blood pressure medicine).
Do not take lisinopril if you have a history of angioedema (severe allergic reaction).
To make sure this medicine is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have ever had:
- heart disease, heart problems such as a recent heart attack;
- low blood pressure;
- low white blood cell count;
- stomach pain;
- if you are on a low-salt diet;
- diabetes;
- liver disease; or
- kidney disease (or if you are on dialysis).
You may also need to avoid taking lisinopril with aliskiren if you have kidney disease.
Triplet: ["lisinopril", "requires disclosure of", "low-salt diet"]

The relation 'requires disclosure of' in the triplet is defined as 'Patients must inform their doctor about the presence of the medical condition or health status specified by the object entity before using the subject drug.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. C. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
